title: Average of 47 women and girls killed daily during Gaza war, UN says
byline: An average of at least 47 women and girls were killed each day during the war in Gaza, according to figures published by U.N. Women on Friday, and the agency warned that deaths have continued six months into a fragile ceasefire.

title: Kanye West concert in Poland cancelled over antisemitic comments
byline: A Kanye West concert in Poland has been cancelled, the venue has announced, following government pressure and condemnation over a string of antisemitic, racist and pro-Nazi comments by the US rapper.

title: Fire breaks out at oil terminal in southern Russia’s Krasnodar region, officials say
byline: A fire broke out at an oil terminal in southern Russia’s Krasnodar region, prompting a large firefighting operation, the region’s emergency operational headquarters said early on Saturday.

title: Showers expected in several provinces after 1pm today
byline: Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the Western, Sabaragamuwa and Southern provinces and in Nuwara-Eliya district after 1.00 pm, the Department of Meteorology stated.

title: ‘Karandeniya Raju’ brought back to Sri Lanka from India
byline: Notorious underworld figure ‘Karandeniya Raju’, wanted in connection with over 15 criminal offences, including murder, was brought back to Sri Lanka yesterday (17) from India by a special team of the Criminal Investigation Department (CID).

title: Son arrested for allegedly beating mother to death following financial dispute
byline: A son has been arrested in connection with the murder of his mother following a financial dispute, said police.

title: QR code fuel quota system for petrol vehicles to resume from midnight
byline: The Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC) announced that the temporarily suspended QR code fuel quota system for petrol vehicles will be reinstated from midnight today (18).

title: US renews sanctions waiver for countries to buy Russian oil
byline: The Trump administration on Friday renewed a waiver allowing countries to buy sanctioned Russian oil and petroleum products at sea for about a month, two days after saying it had no plans to do so.

title: Army soldier killed in building wall collapse at Maduru Oya Training School
byline: A Sri Lanka Army soldier was killed last afternoon (17) following an accident in which the wall of an old building collapsed at the Sri Lanka Army Training School in Maduru Oya, police stated.

title: Demand raised for Dy Defence Minister’s removal amid ongoing Easter attacks probe
byline: Reverend Father Rohan Silva has called on the government to remove Deputy Minister of Defence, Aruna Jayasekera, from his position in order to ensure an impartial investigation into the Easter Sunday bomb attacks.

title: Suspect arrested over attempted shooting targeting “Podi Patty”
byline: A suspect was arrested yesterday (17) by officers attached to the Ahungalla Police Special Task Force (STF) in connection with the attempted murder of “Podi Patty,” the brother of the organized crime figure known as “Loku Patty.”

title: 41 apprehended in fortnight-long crackdown on illegal fishing - Navy
byline: Sri Lanka Navy, in collaboration with the Coast Guard and the Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources, conducted a series of coordinated operations across island waters from April 01 to 15 in an effort to safeguard the nation’s marine resources.

title: Trump hints at resuming attacks if ceasefire with Iran expires without a deal
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump said the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz will remain and attacks will resume if no agreement is reached with Iran, after Tehran said it had fully reopened the strait to commercial vessels but threatened to close it again over the U.S. blockade.

title: US, Iran to hold new nuclear talks in Pakistan: Report
byline: A new round of nuclear talks between the US and Iran is set to take place in the Pakistani capital on Monday, according to a report on Friday.

title: Gautam Adani overtakes Mukesh Ambani as Asia’s richest, check full list
byline: Gautam Adani, founder and chairman of the Adani Group, is now the richest person in Asia. The billionaire has overtaken Mukesh Ambani, the chairman and managing director of Reliance Industries. This comes on the back of gains in Adani Group stock values.

title: Iran announces partial reopening of its airspace
byline: Iran has announced a partial reopening of its airspace after a seven-week hiatus because of the war, state media reported.

title: Father drowns while rescuing children in Mihintale Tank
byline: A 55-year-old man, a resident of Maradan Kulama, tragically drowned last afternoon (17) after leaping into the Maradan Kulama Wewa in Mihintale to save his son and another child.

title: Litro Gas assures uninterrupted LPG supply through May
byline: Litro Gas Lanka has announced that it is capable of maintaining an uninterrupted supply of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) throughout the month of May.

title: Rihanna makes history as first woman to hit 200 million RIAA certifications
byline: Rihanna has reached another major career milestone, becoming the first woman in history to surpass 200 million RIAA-certified singles units, according to recent reporting and data from the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA).

title: 72-hour detention order issued on ‘Karandeniye Raju’ for further investigation
byline: Police Media Spokesperson, Assistant Superintendent of Police (ASP) F.U. Wootler, has confirmed that “Karandeniye Raju,” an organized criminal suspect recently arrested in India and subsequently brought back to Sri Lanka, is currently being detained for 72 hours for further investigation.

title: Strait of Hormuz will return to ‘strict control’ due to US blockade, Iranian military says
byline: The Iranian military’s joint command has released a statement on the situation in the Strait of Hormuz, state media reported.

title: Strait of Hormuz ‘closed’ again, Iranian state media say
byline: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) headquarters said Saturday that the Strait of Hormuz has returned to its previous state of “strict management” following what it described as Washington’s repeated breaches of commitments by continued blockade.

title: Separate incidents of violence against women trigger outrage and police action across Sri Lanka
byline: Three separate incidents involving violent attacks on women have been reported from Moragahahena, Gokarella, and Ragama, prompting police investigations and multiple arrests.

title: Passenger arrested with cigarettes worth over Rs. 5 mln at BIA
byline: A Sri Lankan passenger attempting to smuggle a consignment of foreign-manufactured cigarettes and e-cigarettes valued at Rs. 5.53 million into the country was arrested by Customs officials at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) in the early hours of today (18).

title: Special traffic plan announced for visit of Indian VP
byline: Sri Lanka Police has announced a special traffic plan to be implemented in view of the official visit of the Vice President of India, C. P. Radhakrishnan.

title: Former MP Sampath Athukorala attacked with sharp weapon in Pitigala
byline: Former Galle District Member of Parliament representing the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP), Sampath Athukorala, was injured in an attack carried using a sharp weapon in the Bambarawana area of Pitigala.

title: China humanoid robot half-marathon to showcase technical leaps
byline: More than 300 humanoid robots participating in China’s second robot half-marathon on Sunday will be facing tougher terrain designed to test their technical advancements, as Beijing seeks to develop the industry into a major pillar of its economy.

title: Merchant vessels report gunfire as they attempt to cross Hormuz – report
byline: There have been reports of gunfire after at least two merchant vessels tried to pass through the Strait of Hormuz, the news agency Reuters reports, citing three maritime sources.

title: Iran got ‘a little cute’ but ‘very good conversations going on’ – Trump
byline: US President Donald Trump has addressed the latest developments in the Iran war as Tehran reversed its decision to reopen the Strait of Hormuz today.

title: India’s VP to expand outreach to Indian-origin Tamil community during Sri Lanka visit
byline: In a wide-ranging diplomatic and people-centric engagement, Indian Vice President CP Radhakrishnan will hold talks with Sri Lanka’s top leadership and connect with the Indian-origin Tamil community during his two-day official visit beginning April 19, marking a significant milestone in bilateral ties between the two countries.

title: Sri Lanka ratifies ILO convention on eliminating violence, harassment in workplaces
byline: Sri Lanka’s Permanent Representative to the United Nations in Geneva, Ambassador Sumith Dassanayake, has deposited the instrument of ratification of the Violence and Harassment Convention, 2019 (No. 190), with the Director-General of the International Labour Organization (ILO), Mr Gilbert F. Houngbo.

title: 2 Indian-flagged vessels attacked by Iran gunboats in Hormuz, crew safe: Sources
byline: Two Indian-flagged vessels were fired at by Iranian gunboats in the Strait of Hormuz today, sources have said. No one was injured and the vessels were not damaged, they said. The two ships, however, had to turn back after the incident northeast of Oman in the shipping lane critical for oil trade.

title: Iran says no date set for next round of negotiations with US
byline: No date has been set for the next round of negotiations between Iran and the United States, Iran’s deputy foreign minister said on Saturday, adding that a framework of understanding must be agreed first.

title: India summons Iran’s ambassador after Indian-flagged tankers shot at near Strait of Hormuz
byline: India on Saturday summoned Iran’s ambassador in New Delhi after two Indian vessels were forced to reverse course in the Strait of Hormuz following reports of gunfire from Iran’s Revolutionary Guard.

title: CBSL Chief discusses geopolitical risks and trade settlement mechanisms with China and India
byline: The Governor of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka (CBSL), Dr. Nandalal Weerasinghe held bilateral discussions with the Governor of the People’s Bank of China, Dr. Pan Gongsheng on the sidelines of the International Monetary Fund–World Bank Spring Meetings 2026.
